# kafka_quota (List Resource)

Lists existing client quotas, e.g. to generate `import` blocks and configuration with `terraform query`. Default quotas (no entity name) are included; quotas on combined entities (e.g. user + client-id) are skipped because `kafka_quota` manages one entity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every single-entity quota, including default ones
list "kafka_quota" "all" {
  provider = kafka
}

# User quotas of the orders team
list "kafka_quota" "orders_users" {
  provider = kafka

  config {
    entity_type        = "user"
    entity_name_prefix = "orders-"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `entity_name_prefix` (String) Only quotas whose entity name starts with this prefix (excludes default quotas).
- `entity_type` (String) Only quotas of this entity type: `user`, `client-id` or `ip`.
